outline.text: Five issuers, each opening on its latest finished run
Stable credit with thin headroom: leverage is falling, but the 2028 notes need refinancing before the engine programme pays back.
Improving: volume recovery and a cleared 2027 maturity leave two years of runway.
A new run as of 30 Sep 2026 is in progress. This is the run as of 30 Jun 2026.

Weakening: private-label losses in the two largest retail accounts, a third consecutive quarter of negative free cash flow and a facility that is now 70% drawn mean the springing covenant is likely to be tested at the December quarter end, earlier than management has guided.
Stable: subscriber losses are offset by pricing; leverage is flat at 5.2x.
The run as of 30 Sep 2026 failed. This is the run as of 31 Mar 2026.
Not established for this run: the run stopped at its cost cap before the modules that form the view had finished.
Seven modules delivered; their findings can be read.
